summary: Add test coverage for the old worker shutdown behavior with enableCancelWorkerPollsOnShutdown=false before this server setting changes to default in the future.
userImpact: Users need test coverage to ensure worker shutdown behavior remains compatible when the server setting enableCancelWorkerPollsOnShutdown defaults change.
proposedFix: Add tests covering the old worker shutdown behavior with frontend.enableCancelWorkerPollsOnShutdown=false
keyQuote: We should make sure we have tests covering the old behavior, `frontend.enableCancelWorkerPollsOnShutdown=false`
